caption:
The video captures a low-angle sunset view of a calm sea. The sun rests on the horizon, casting a bright vertical reflection column across the water to the right. In the left foreground a clear glass sphere sits on a bed of wet, rounded pebbles at the shoreline. The sphere holds an inverted image of the scene, with a curved horizon line and a glowing vertical streak of reflected sunlight.

The composition otherwise stays fixed, but thin sheets of water repeatedly advance and retreat over the pebbles in the lower half. This reshapes the wet boundary around the stones near the sphere. The sun's reflection column on the open water shimmers, its bright patches and broken highlights shifting over time while its vertical position holds. The streak inside the glass ball flickers in shape and intensity, tracking the same surface motion. The inverted horizon within the sphere remains present throughout, with only minor internal shimmering.
